title: Fit Narration To Seven Seconds
tests: Tests fitting exact narration to the source clip's duration and explicit start/end windows without changing the picture timing.

exact_text.text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
exact_text.read_as: Audio transcription: “Brooke, you with me?” Visible captions: “Rook, you with me?” and “Right here, Vega.”

faults.what: The requested narration is absent; the supplied audio transcription instead contains an unrelated radio call.
On-screen dialogue captions appear at 2.6 and 4.4 seconds despite the explicit no-captions requirement.
The required final word “home” is absent, so the specified narration endpoint is not met.

judge.summary: The seven-second output retains cockpit imagery but fails the audio replacement and includes prohibited dialogue captions.

must_haves.item: The final video remains seven seconds long and preserves the original cockpit footage at its original speed and framing.
must_haves.why: The output is confirmed as seven seconds and includes matching cockpit imagery, but one source still cannot establish preservation of the full footage, original speed, or framing throughout.

must_haves.item: The narrator speaks the exact supplied script, with no omitted or additional words.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription contains only “Brooke, you with me?” rather than the requested script.

must_haves.item: Speech begins within the first half-second, and the final word “home” finishes during the last half-second without being cut off.
must_haves.why: The requested narration and its final word “home” are absent.

must_haves.item: The delivery sounds calm and intelligible, without unnaturally rushed speech or conspicuous time-stretching artifacts.
must_haves.why: A transcription does not establish vocal calmness, pacing, intelligibility, or audio artifacts, and the requested narration is missing.

must_haves.item: The original radio calls and other source sounds are absent; there is no added music or on-screen text.
must_haves.why: The audio transcription contains a radio-style dialogue line, and the output visibly includes dialogue captions. Music and other background sounds cannot be assessed from the supplied evidence.
